baseline_models.focus_anchor: طَلْحٍ at word 1 is directly modified by مَّنضُودٍ at word 2.
baseline_models.mechanism: The plant noun supplies a tree or crop body; the passive adjective pictures its natural units packed one above another, making vertical continuity rather than mere quantity the organizing feature.

activation_trace.role: The known ṭalḥ tree supplies the concrete botanical body whose growth or produce is described.
Layered natural bodies, explicitly including packed ṭalḥ, supply the vertical packing mechanism.

changed_reading.before: A named tree carrying a generally favorable adjective.
changed_reading.after: A tree whose growth or produce forms a continuous vertical body, layer pressed upon layer.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive form مَّنضُودٍ makes prior ordering visible within the description of طَلْحٍ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Joining items in an ordered series and stacking household stores shift the plant from spontaneous scenery toward provision already gathered, sorted, and presented.

activation_trace.role: The tree supplies the botanical material that can be treated as prepared provision.
Joining thing to thing in orderly sequence supplies deliberate arrangement rather than undifferentiated plenty.
Household goods piled in readiness supply the presentation-and-provision analogy.

changed_reading.before: Vegetation simply encountered in a landscape.
changed_reading.after: Botanical provision already ordered and presented with the readiness of household stores.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding repeated group label activates the social branch of ن ض د: packed units can form a company whose adjacency gives strength, while ي م ن marks that association as blessed.

activation_trace.role: A gathered company by which one gains strength turns packing into a social relation.
Repeated companionship and close association supply the beneficiaries as a cohesive company.
Blessing supplies the positive value carried by that clustered company.

changed_reading.before: Vertical density is the endpoint of the image.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates branch-distant agricultural senses from ع ر ب in a phrase whose local surface role is not horticultural. It remains anchored in the focus tree and its ordered adjective, with poured water nearby; downstream prose should present it only as a horticultural systems echo, not as a lexical replacement for 56:37.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The model operates on طَلْحٍ as a tree and on مَّنضُودٍ as the result of orderly arrangement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries the weariness and corruption branches of ط ل ح beside the primary tree sense rather than translating the noun by them. The reading remains focus-anchored in that same root and gains a visible reversal from de-sharpening, re-creation, and state-change cues; downstream prose should label it a lexical-shadow transformation, not the verse's botanical denotation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The polysemy belongs to focus word طَلْحٍ, while مَّنضُودٍ supplies the ordered end-state.

activation_trace.role: Weariness and emaciation supply a deficit shadow carried by the focus root.
Corruption opposed to soundness supplies the stronger negative pole of that shadow.
Orderly joining supplies the repaired end-state into which the deficit is imaginatively reversed.
Removal of thorns and sharpness supplies an immediately adjacent subtraction of harm.
New creation supplies replacement of the depleted condition.
Causing a new state supplies the directional transformation into ordered abundance.

changed_reading.before: Only a flourishing botanical image with no remembered deficit.
changed_reading.after: At the level of lexical shadow, weariness and corruption are carried into a de-harmed, newly made, ordered abundance.

strongest_changes: The 56:28-33 sequence turns spatial stacking into safe, irrigated, abundant, uninterrupted, and unbarred availability.
The household senses of ن ض د and the raised furnishing of 56:34 recast the grove as a deliberately prepared habitat.
The closing group and first-to-later cues activate a social-temporal analogue in which packed layers mirror mutually supporting cohorts.
summary.what_was_special: The focus begins as a compact two-word geometry, but the ordered context progressively assigns that geometry tactile, ecological, distributive, domestic, regenerative, and social functions without dislodging the tree-and-layer anchor.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet's ط ل ح inventory permits a known tree and mentions banana-like interpretation within its scope, but the exact botanical referent remains unresolved.
Projecting later creation, firstness, and cohort structure backward onto the focus is an abductive mechanism rather than a grammatical entailment.
The furnished-grove, regulated-horticulture, and reordered-deficit readings should remain explicitly analogical or branch-led.
